issues.failure_explanation: The right-hand side of (eq:Enrichment) contains only tangential jumps on interior faces, and the jump operator is defined only for interior faces. At a boundary vertex j one has E v_h(j)=0 while v_h(j) is constrained only by the vanishing of boundary face midpoints, so no interior-face jump controls |v_h(j)-E v_h(j)|; the proof's nodal bound covers only interior vertices. Counterexample: on the criss-cross mesh of a square (four triangles around one interior vertex), the Crouzeix--Raviart checkerboard mode with corner values alternating +1/-1 and center value 0 lies in V_h (continuous at interior midpoints, zero at boundary midpoints), has zero tangential gradient jump on every interior face, but E v_h = 0 and v_h nonzero; hence the left-hand side of (eq:Enrichment) is positive while the right-hand side is zero.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Extend the jump notation to boundary faces with the zero extension (jump = tangential trace of the interior simplex), include boundary faces in the sum of (eq:Enrichment), bound boundary-vertex values through the boundary-midpoint condition, and carry the boundary faces through the chain and bubble arguments of part 2 with one-sided patches (this works verbatim since the bubble functions vanish on the remaining boundary). All final estimates and stated results then hold unchanged.
issues.overall_effect: (eq:Enrichment) is false as stated; the derivation of (eq:Enrichment2) starts from it, and lem:confComp is invoked in the proofs of thm:mainResult (Steps 1-3), thm:Apriori, thm:ApproxProperties and thm:AprioriConf, so all of these proofs are unsupported as written.
issues.title: Enrichment estimate sums only over interior faces: false for boundary-adjacent elements (checkerboard counterexample)
issues.why_classification: The defect is a degenerate boundary case with a standard fix (boundary-face jump terms appear in the same tangential-jump enrichment bounds in the cited literature); the method, every statement, rate, and the advertised scope survive, and no new nontrivial lemma is needed.

issues.failure_explanation: In part 2 the shift is defined by v_h while the jumps and arguments involve the different function e_h = v_h - u_h. The shift-change (itm:shiftChange) changes a shift |grad v_h(T)| at the price delta |F(grad v_h(T'))-F(grad v_h(T))|^2, which is equivalent to a phi_{|grad v_h(T)|}-jump of v_h, not of e_h as written in (eq:Proofaaassskkkkk-); likewise the equivalences of prop:Distances / itm:Udal require matching shift and argument vectors, so (eq:Proofaaq34) and the subsequent absorption steps are unjustified. These displays are false: for phi(t)=t^p/p, p>2, take a face gamma with T=T_-(gamma), v_h = M psi_{gamma'} (CR basis function at another face gamma' of T, so |grad v_h| ~ M/h on T and 0 on T_+(gamma)), and e_h with jump t/h across gamma, t << M; then (eq:Proofaaassskkkkk-) with the trivial chain reads M^{p-2} t^2 <= C_delta t^p + delta M^{p-2} t^2, which fails for M >> t. The statement (eq:Enrichment2) itself also fails for p>2, already for v=0: take e_h to be a plateau mode (constant ~K on T and the neighbor T' sharing the face gamma', with grad e_h ~ K/h only on outer neighbors, so that e_h - E e_h has gradient ~K/h on T) and v_h = M psi_{gamma'}; the left side is ~ M^{p-2} K^2 h^{d-p} while the right side is ~ K^p h^{d-p}.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Restate part 2 of lem:confComp for a single function (u_h=0, where shift and argument coincide; the given proof is then valid) and derive the e_h-estimates needed in thm:mainResult by linearity of E: apply the single-function estimate separately to v_h and to u_h with comparison function w=u, combine with shift-changes whose penalties delta ||F(grad v_h)-F(grad u_h)||^2 are absorbable, and conclude via the quasi-metric property of the F-distance and lem:Oscillation; the false general mixed estimate must be dropped. Alternatively, thm:mainResult follows from thm:AprioriConf combined with the cited result of Kaltenbach, as noted in the paper's comparison remark.
issues.overall_effect: Steps 1-3 of the proof of thm:mainResult absorb the enrichment terms precisely through the v=0 case of (eq:Enrichment2), which is false for p>2; hence the self-contained medius proof of thm:mainResult, and with it thm:Apriori, is unsupported as written. thm:ApproxProperties and thm:AprioriConf use only the single-function case u_h=0 (i.e. e_h=v_h), for which the written proof is correct, so they are not invalidated by this root.
issues.title: Estimate (eq:Enrichment2) mixes v_h-defined shifts with e_h-arguments: key proof steps and the statement itself fail for p>2
issues.why_classification: An auxiliary estimate is false and the main theorem's direct proof requires a nontrivial reorganization, but the single-function case proved by the same text together with the paper's own tools (or the stated Kaltenbach-based implication) recovers thm:mainResult and thm:Apriori verbatim; no advertised result, regime, or rate is lost.

issues.failure_explanation: The last step estimates the integral of phi_{|grad u(x)|}(|Pi_0 w|) over an element by the integral of phi_{|grad u(y)|}(|w(y)|) for w = grad u - chi. Jensen's inequality is applied with a shift |grad u| that varies over the element, which is not justified. For phi(t)=t^p/p with 1<p<2 the intermediate inequality is false: take grad u = (M,0) on a strip S of relative measure epsilon inside T and grad u = 0 on T\S (a ramp), and chi=0; then the Pi_0-term scales like epsilon^p M^p while the full term scales like epsilon M^p, so the ratio blows up like epsilon^{p-1} as epsilon -> 0. Hence (eq:approxInc) is not proved by the displayed argument; the needed quasi-best approximation of Pi_0 grad u in the F-distance requires a different proof.

issues.failure_explanation: lem:confComp yields the conjugated term with (phi_{|grad v|})^*(h |div A(grad v)|), and lem:Oscillation and the oscillation osc^2 are built from the conjugate (phi)^*; but thm:ApproxProperties states (and (eq:ProofTemp0223) writes) the un-conjugated phi_{|grad v|}(h|div A(grad v)|), and the proof of thm:AprioriConf then applies lem:Oscillation to the un-conjugated term phi_{|grad u|}(h|f|), which is invalid as written. For phi(t)=t^p/p one has phi(t)=t^p/p versus phi^*(t)=t^{p'}/p', which are not comparable for p != 2; for p>2 the stated theorem is strictly stronger than what the proof yields. The same dropped conjugate appears in the Step-1 conclusion display of thm:mainResult's proof.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Insert the conjugate * in the statement of thm:ApproxProperties, in (eq:ProofTemp0223), in the two displays of thm:AprioriConf's proof, and in the Step-1 conclusion display of thm:mainResult's proof; the corrected terms are exactly what lem:confComp and lem:Oscillation provide, so thm:AprioriConf and all advertised claims remain intact.
issues.overall_effect: thm:ApproxProperties as stated is not supported by its proof (for p>2 it claims strictly more than the proved conjugated version), and thm:AprioriConf's proof contains an application of lem:Oscillation to a term it does not control.
issues.title: Convex conjugate dropped in the div A(grad v) and h|f| terms
